review.note: The national model: each Land's building code (LBO) broadly follows it. Stair values are DIN 18065 (from secondary sources; the standard is paywalled) for buildings with up to two dwellings and inside dwellings, and are not building law for houses in building classes 1 and 2; the ceiling rule does not apply to residential building classes 1 and 2 either. Not checked by this pack: stair headroom,…

source.name: Bauministerkonferenz (ARGEBAU); DIN; DIBt (MVV TB), Musterbauordnung (MBO) and DIN 18065:2020-08 Gebäudetreppen (model)

rules.label: Riser height
rules.note: Up to two dwellings / inside dwellings; 190 mm in other buildings. Stride rule 2s + a = 590-650 mm.

rules.label: Tread depth (going)
rules.note: Required stairs, up to two dwellings / inside dwellings; 260 mm in other buildings.

rules.label: Stair width
rules.note: Usable width, up to two dwellings / inside dwellings; 1000 mm in other buildings.

rules.label: Ceiling height
rules.note: Attic rooms 2.20 m over half the floor area. Does not apply to residential buildings of building classes 1 and 2.

rules.label: Glazing, share of floor area
rules.note: Window openings (structural size) at least 1/8 of the net floor area.
